name: wicked-interactive
description: The wicked family's document engine: write-once version lineage and forking (data-wid anchoring), HTML / PDF / native PowerPoint / video export, captioned demo recording and theme learning behind one local API. wicked-crew spawns and proxies it; you edit, rewind, fork and export in wicked-studio. The plugin's serve and assist skills start the engine and keep a Claude session on its wicked-bus events.
